issues.title: Unavailable verifier marks decomposition nodes "failed" and cascades skips through the queue
issues.description: `leanRetryLoop` now returns `{valid: false, unavailable: true}` when the verifier is missing, but `formalizeNode` was not updated and still maps `result.valid ? "verified" : "failed"` — so with `LEAN_VERIFIER_URL` unset (now the default, see below), every node with a deductive pipeline is marked "Failed" with empty `verificationErrors`, and `useAutoFormalizeQueue` (line 113-119) then skips all dependents with the misleading message "Skipped: dependency X failed". "Formalize All" without a verifier now fails an entire graph that previously completed.

issues.title: New "unavailable" status silently collapsed to "unverified" in node-scoped flows
issues.description: `toNodeVerificationStatus` was not extended, so its `default` arm swallows `"unavailable"` (page.tsx:350 routes the node pipeline through it), and `fromNodeVerificationStatus` maps back to `"none"` — in decomposition mode the "Verifier offline — proof not checked" banner and badge never appear, and session restore (page.tsx:186) loses the state. The fix this branch implements is invisible for per-node verification.

issues.title: Removed localhost:3100 default breaks the documented zero-config dev flow
issues.description: The base defaulted `LEAN_VERIFIER_URL` to `http://localhost:3100`; now an unset variable short-circuits to `unavailableResponse("verifier-not-configured")` without ever trying the verifier. `docker-compose.yml` publishes the verifier on 3100 but nothing sets `LEAN_VERIFIER_URL` for the Next.js app, so the README's `docker compose up` + `npm run dev` flow now reports every proof as unchecked until the developer manually exports the variable.

issues.title: Docs still describe the removed mock-fallback behavior
issues.description: README lines 60, 84, and 92 ("falls back to a mock response", "defaults to `http://localhost:3100`", "mock `{ valid: true, mock: true }`") and docs/USER_GUIDE.md lines 203 and 345 ("a mock 'valid' response is returned") document behavior this branch deliberately removed; USER_GUIDE's badge list (lines 197-201) also omits the new "Verifier offline" state. Project CLAUDE.md requires updating these docs in the same PR as user-facing behavior changes.

issues.title: Network failure reaching the app's own verification route still reports "Verification Failed"
issues.description: The catch blocks in `handleReVerify` (line 164) and `handleLeanIterate` (line 206) set status `"invalid"` when `verifyLean`'s fetch rejects, so a proof that was never checked still displays as a failed proof — the exact misreporting class this change set out to eliminate, left unhandled for the app-server hop.

issues.title: No tests for the new unavailable-status mapping logic
issues.description: `verifyResultToStatus`, the `verifyLean` `unavailable` plumbing, and `leanRetryLoop`'s early-return on unavailable (the load-bearing "unavailable wins over valid" invariant) shipped without any unit tests, despite the project guideline to write Vitest tests alongside implementation.
